claims: WrestleMania 42 Night 2 is on Sunday, April 19, 2026.
WrestleMania 42 Night 2 venue is Allegiant Stadium, Las Vegas, Nevada.
WrestleMania 42 Night 2 streams live on Peacock in the US.
WrestleMania 42 Night 2 streams live on Netflix internationally.
WrestleMania 42 Night 1 is headlined by Cody Rhodes vs. Randy Orton.
WrestleMania 42 Night 2 main event is World Heavyweight Championship: CM Punk (c) vs. Roman Reigns.
WrestleMania 42 Night 2 features WWE Women's Championship: Jade Cargill (c) vs. Rhea Ripley.
WrestleMania 42 Night 2 features Intercontinental Championship Ladder Match: Penta (c) vs. Rey Mysterio vs. Je'Von Evans vs. Dragon Lee vs. JD McDonagh vs. Rusev.
WrestleMania 42 Night 2 features United States Championship: Sami Zayn (c) vs. Trick Williams.
WrestleMania 42 Night 2 features singles match: Brock Lesnar vs. Oba Femi.
WrestleMania 42 Night 2 features singles match: Finn Bálor vs. Dominik Mysterio.
WrestleMania 42 Night 2 features a 6-Pack Ladder Match for the Intercontinental Championship.
